name: journal-frontier-radar
description: Use Kimi WebBridge to inventory and read a journal's recent articles, map topics and keywords, assess research frontiers, and formulate evidence-grounded open scientific questions.

interface.shortDescription: Audit recent journal topics and scientific frontiers.
interface.longDescription: Build a complete, traceable inventory of a user-selected journal over 1 month to 2 years, read every accessible article, quantify its recent focus, and connect those themes to current advances and unresolved scientific questions.
defaultPrompt: 分析一个期刊最近6个月的研究热点与前沿问题。
审计目标期刊近1年的全部文章并生成趋势报告。
比较期刊关注热点与领域真实前沿。
